config.description: Replica of the original train_model.py: frozen backbone but BatchNorm left in train mode, plain CE, flip+rotation, early stop on val accuracy.
Same as A with the BatchNorm bug fixed (frozen blocks stay in eval mode) and early stop on val macro-F1.
C with a 3x lower head learning rate.
C + mild brightness/contrast jitter (training only) + weight decay 1e-4.
C + fine-tune the last two feature blocks (backbone lr 1e-4) + weight decay 1e-4.

selection.rationale: Highest mean inner-validation macro-F1: C_frozen_weighted (0.898, SE 0.019). Among configurations within one SE of it, the simplest (B_frozen_bn_eval) is chosen. Outer test folds were not used for this choice.

limitations.message: Healthy: only 1 independent generation session(s) are tested per fold (threshold 3). Per-fold and pooled metrics for this class are driven by very few independent samples and are NOT statistically reliable.
